digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend facade and Jira adapter
propositions: The reconciler core directly accesses Jira adapter modules without a named interface; a Backend facade and role Protocols are needed to enable pluggable backends.

RemoteRef (vendor, instance, remote_id) identity type and IdentityConvention for the rebar-id label format must be extracted from four inlined core call sites and unified in adapters/jira/identity.py without rewiring those sites in this story.
JiraBackend must implement Backend as a pure delegation shim wrapping existing Jira modules (AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields, comment_limits) with zero behavior change.

Opt-in capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) must be detected via isinstance() with @runtime_checkable, using behavior-based dispatch rather than structural introspection or a capabilities() method.

A backend-agnostic contract test suite parameterized over JiraBackend (injected mock transport) and FakeBackend must verify outbound-to-inbound round-trips, sanitizer idempotence, IdentityConvention correctness, and capability-gated method invocation.

Characterization tests must assert pure Jira mapper outputs (outbound fields, ADF text fit, inbound extraction) are byte-for-byte identical to pre-story main on representative fixtures, proving delegation preserves current behavior.
